define_skippable_module: use the skippable decorator to define a PyTorch module with named stash and pop skip connections
stash_skip_tensor: yield a stash command to save a named skip tensor for later use by downstream layers
pop_skip_tensor: yield a pop command to retrieve a previously stashed skip tensor by its declared name
isolate_skip_namespace: call isolate on a skippable module to assign skip tensors to a Namespace for reuse without conflict
verify_skippables_integrity: run verify_skippables on an nn.Sequential module to check all stash and pop pairs are matched
